markets.rules_primary: If the House has conducted any recorded vote on legislation that would materially restrict birth tourism or birthright citizenship for children of temporary visitors after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This includes:
Roll call votes
Recorded votes
Yea-and-nay votes
Electronic votes (in the House)
Division/standing votes

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Voice votes where individual member positions are not recorded
Unanimous consent agreements without a recorded vote
Votes in committee, unless the bill/motion specifically refers to a committee vote
Procedural determinations by the presiding officer
Deemed passage without an actual vote

For clarity:
A vote on cloture regarding the bill/motion, including cloture on a motion to proceed to the bill/motion, DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on the rule governing debate of the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion if the bill/motion specifically refers to that rule
A vote on a motion to proceed to the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on final passage DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on an amendment to the bill/motion does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion unless the bill/motion specifically refers to that amendment

markets.rules_primary: If Backstreet Boys performs (or it is announced that they will perform at) at the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027 during the official event timeframe, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Additional clarification(s):

Backstreet Boys appears on stage or in the official broadcast or stream; AND

Backstreet Boys actively and perceptibly contributes to a musical performance by singing (including audible lead or backing vocals), rapping, playing a musical instrument, DJ-ing, or conducting a live band; AND

Is either a scheduled performer, a guest appearance during another artist's set, or is formally announced as a performer by official event organizers or Backstreet Boys's official representatives.

Note: This Contract may resolve on the announcement of Backstreet Boys’s anticipated performance at the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027. If an announced Backstreet Boys later withdraws from the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027, this will not affect the resolution of the Contract.

The following constitutes a performance and IS encompassed by the Payout Criterion:

A full solo performance of one or more songs.

A collaborative or joint performance in which Backstreet Boys is physically present and actively contributes musically.

A guest appearance during another artist's set in which Backstreet Boys performs at least one full verse, chorus, or musical segment.

A medley in which Backstreet Boys is present and actively performing, even if Backstreet Boys's portion is partial.

A performance in which Backstreet Boys performs entirely via an officially produced and sanctioned satellite feed, video link, or holographic display that is presented as part of the official live event program, provided that the performance is real-time or was produced specifically for and presented exclusively within the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027.

A DJ set in which Backstreet Boys is the performing DJ operating equipment live, regardless of whether Backstreet Boys sings.

A pre-recorded performance segment presented as part of the official event program, provided it is attributed to Backstreet Boys by the official event organizers and presented as a performance (rather than a tribute, retrospective, or archival clip).

A performance that begins within the official event timeframe but extends beyond it due to scheduling overrun, provided the performance commenced during the official timeframe.

A performance at a rescheduled version of the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027 where the reschedule occurs within one year of the original event date, pursuant to the postponement provisions below.

markets.rules_primary: If Joe Rogan performs as correspondent in 60 Minutes, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this Contract, Joe Rogan satisfies the Payout Criterion if either:

Official Announcement:
Joe Rogan is officially announced, confirmed, or publicly credited as cast to perform correspondent in 60 Minutes, regardless of whether the performance ultimately occurs; OR

Actual Performance:
Joe Rogan appears on stage, on screen, or in recorded content as correspondent in any official performance, showing, or release of 60 Minutes.

Additional clarification(s):

If 60 Minutes is entirely cancelled or abandoned before any official performance or release occurs, but Joe Rogan was officially announced in correspondent, the Contract will resolve to “Yes.”

If multiple people are announced for correspondent (e.g., alternating cast, dual casting), and Joe Rogan is among them, the Contract will resolve to “Yes.” b

The Contract may resolve to “No” prior to the Expiration Date if:
(a) 60 Minutes is cancelled or completes its run without Joe Rogan being announced or performing in correspondent, or
(b) another person is officially announced as the sole exclusive performer for correspondent.

markets.rules_primary: If Clairo releases a new song in 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market resolves based on public availability on Spotify under the artist's official discography. For markets specifying "new song" or "new music," the release must be an original composition first released during the time period. Re-recordings (unless in a new language), remasters, radio edits, clean/explicit versions of existing tracks, remixes, live versions, acoustic versions, instrumentals, demos, alternative takes, or reproductions of songs already on Spotify do not qualify as "new." Songs released in a new language count as new releases. Cosmetic changes like title edits, artwork updates, or re-uploads of the same audio do not constitute new releases. If a release is withdrawn after appearing on Spotify, it still qualifies if verifiably public at any point during the time period. The effective release time is the first verified moment of public availability, regardless of displayed metadata dates. Region-limited or staggered releases qualify once publicly available in any official Spotify market. If the artist is deceased, posthumous releases attributed to them as primary or featured performer still qualify.
markets.title: Will Clairo release a new song 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has taken any executive action establishing a tariff of 100% or greater specifically on imported generic pharmaceutical products before Nov 3, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The action must specify an effective date, but it does not need to be before Nov 3, 2026. Exemptions or reduced rates for particular products, companies, or countries do not prevent qualification. 

The qualifying action must be of the specific type designated (executive order, presidential memorandum, proclamation, directive, determination, or finding), be signed by the President personally during the specified time period, and explicitly address the topic in the document's operative provisions, title, or official White House summary. Actions must have legal or policy effect - ceremonial proclamations without policy impact do not qualify unless specifically included. Actions that only incidentally mention the topic, statements without formal action, actions by cabinet members, legislative proposals without executive action, and signing statements do not qualify. The action must be publicly announced or documented by a Source Agency before expiration.
markets.title: Will Donald Trump issue any executive action on establishing a tariff of 100% or greater specifically on imported generic pharmaceutical products during before Nov 3, 2026?
